row.name: Senflax
row.description: A potent, pale yellow liquid neurotoxin. It temporarily induces full-body paralysis and disrupts concentration while leaving victims fully conscious, making it a favorite of bounty hunters. Exposure: Triggered via touch, consumption, or injection. Target must make an HT-4 (or Poison Resistance-4) roll. Failure: Deals 1d toxic damage. The target suffers the Paralysis affliction for 1 hour or until treated with an Antidote Kit. Success: Deals 1d toxic damage, and the target's DX is reduced by -4 for 1 hour (or until treated). Critical Success: Deals 1d toxic damage, and the target's DX is reduced by -1.
